title: Screw Master
description: A spatial disassembly puzzle. Steel plates are bolted to a wooden backboard — click a screw, then click a spare hole to move it. Empty both screws of a plate and it free-falls away, uncovering new holes. Only 2 spare holes, and screws hidden under a plate stay locked until that plate drops.
author: Game Portal

title: 2048 Merge
description: Slide and merge matching tiles to reach 2048! A classic, relaxing number puzzle you can't put down.
author: Game Portal

title: Snake
description: Widescreen Snake! Eat the glowing dots to grow and clear each level's quota to advance. Rising combo audio, particle bursts and neon glow. 3 lives.
author: Game Portal

title: Pac-Man
description: Eat all the dots and dodge the ghosts in the classic maze chase. Grab a power pellet to fight back!
author: Game Portal

title: Snake Pro
description: The classic snake, upgraded for a widescreen arena. Eat apples to grow and grab the bolt for a speed boost.
author: Game Portal

title: Plane War
description: Widescreen vertical shooter! Auto-fire your fighter, dodge enemy raids and survive boss waves. Level by level the skies get deadlier. Explosions, screen shake & rising combo audio.
author: Game Portal

title: Fruit Catcher
description: Widescreen Fruit Catcher! Slide the basket to catch falling fruit — dodge bombs, chain combos, beat each level's catch goal. Juicy sound + particle splashes.
author: Game Portal

title: Whack-a-Mole
description: Widescreen Whack-a-Mole! Smash the popping moles before time runs out — avoid bombs. Grid grows and bombs multiply each level. Combo audio + splash effects.
author: Game Portal

title: Match-3
description: Swap adjacent gems on a widescreen board to line up three or more. Chain combos and beat your score in 20 moves.
author: Game Portal

title: Breakout Storm
description: Widescreen brick-breaking arcade action! Three lives, a wide paddle, dense brick formations, escalating combo sounds, screen shake and particle explosions. Smash them all!
author: Game Portal

title: Memory Match
description: Flip the cards to find the pairs and train your memory. Multiple themed decks.
author: Game Portal

title: Tetris
description: The classic falling-block puzzle — rotate and drop to clear full lines. Speed and planning.
author: Game Portal

title: Minesweeper
description: The classic minesweeper — deduce where every mine is hidden. Logic meets luck.
author: Game Portal

title: Speed Racer
description: Full-width racing! Dodge oncoming traffic on the highway and chase the longest distance. Keyboard or swipe.
author: Game Portal

title: Sky Fighter
description: Widescreen side-scrolling shoot 'em up! Fly right, grab power-ups, blast incoming squadrons and bosses. Levels ramp up density & speed. Juicy explosions and audio.
author: Game Portal

title: Tank Battle
description: Widescreen tank combat! Destroy every enemy tank to clear the level. Brick cover, elite armour and escalating waves. Cannon booms, blasts & screen shake.
author: Game Portal

title: Asteroids
description: Classic arcade shooting! Pilot your ship through the asteroid belt, blast rocks and dodge UFO fire. Arrows to steer and thrust, space to fire.
author: Smarty Saini

title: Bouncy Ball
description: A physics bouncing game! Guide the ball as it bounces between walls and obstacles to collect points. Mouse/touch to play.
author: Ritesh Poriya

title: Space Invaders
description: Defend Earth! Shoot down waves of descending aliens and dodge their bullets. Retro arcade cabinet style, touch supported.
author: ShawTim

title: Bubble Shooter
description: Aim, bounce, match three! A physics-based bubble shooter with wall ricochet. Clear bubbles of the same color. Classic arcade feel.
author: ShawTim

title: Tetris 2
description: Another take on Tetris! SRS rotation with wall kicks and 10 difficulty levels. Keyboard and touch controls.
author: ShawTim

title: Memory Cards
description: Classic memory pairing! Flip cards to find matching pictures, with multiple difficulties and high-contrast cards for all ages.
author: bryanherger

title: Bubble Pop
description: Pop the colorful bubbles floating by! Adjustable difficulty, bubble count and speed, satisfying sound effects, touch and keyboard supported.
author: bryanherger

title: Fireworks Show
description: Tap anywhere to launch dazzling fireworks! Real particle physics and gravity, 8 color schemes, the perfect way to relax.
author: bryanherger

title: Music Shapes
description: Tap colorful shapes to play music! Each shape is a note, a cheerful C-major harmony that sparks creativity.
author: bryanherger

title: Picture Puzzle
description: Drag six pieces to complete the picture! Memorize the preview, then scramble. Keyboard also works — trains observation.
author: bryanherger

title: Color Splash
description: Tap anywhere to paint with bold colors and music! Minimal interaction, great for kids to create freely.
author: bryanherger

title: Fruit Slicer
description: Swipe with finger or mouse to slice flying fruit! Classic fruit-cutting fun — beware the bombs 💣, missing fruit costs a life. Combo streaks earn bonus points.
author: Have Fun

title: Cake Workshop
description: Stack your own cake layer by layer! Pick the base, filling and decorations, then light the candles 🕯️ for your sweet masterpiece.
author: Have Fun

title: Endless Runner
description: Infinite runner! Tap to jump over cacti and rocks as the speed ramps up. How many meters can you run?
author: Have Fun

title: Watermelon Merge
description: The classic merge game! Drop fruits so matching ones collide and combine into bigger ones, all the way to the 🍉 watermelon. Addictive.
author: Have Fun
